findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice mcqs for Chapter 11 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 164 questions numbered 1-164; by section: 11.1 9, 11.2 33, 11.3 8, 11.4 6, 11.5 16, 11.6 16, 11.7 24, 11.8 27, 11.9 4, 11.10 13, 11.11 8. Keys: {'a': 41, 'b': 41, 'c': 41, 'd': 41}.

Covers every section 11.1-11.11 in order (aliphatic and aromatic hydrocarbons, alkanes and their naming, shapes and properties, bond fission, inertness of alkanes, free radical substitution, alkenes: naming, preparation, structure, carbocations and inductive effect, addition reactions, polymerization, conjugated dienes, isomerism, organic redox). Small counts (formulae, electronegativity difference, O₂ in combustion) were recomputed in Python; none repeats the chapter exercise. Book corrections followed: heptane C₇H₁₆, tert-butyl = 1,1-dimethylethyl, cyclopentane C₅H₁₀, Br⁻ is the nucleophile, 2-bromoethanol as the halohydrin, metamers ethoxyethane/methoxypropane, balanced ethane combustion giving water, ethene as the ripening hormone.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
